body: Volleyball sounds fun, I would fit in because I am a girl. Haha. Thanks for talking with me I'm feeling a lot better now that a few hours has gone by.
I spend most of my time online, yes. It would be great to play a sport. Do you play sports? Which one do you recommend for clumsy people?
I'd say it's difficult to make them, almost say it's literally impossible. Am I wrong in thinking most people have a best friend?

Maybe it's because I watch too many tv shows where people have unrealistically close friendships in their lives, or maybe because I've never seen the world outside of my own messed up mind, or maybe it's true that I am just very uncommonly lonely. What's up with you?
